description: MCP server registry for Digital Seed. The 'community' block is informational, NOT an install manifest: no auto-installer reads it. Verify every package yourself (`npm view <name>`), pin the exact version, and read the code before installing. See mcp/README.md.

seed-rag.description: Semantic search over embedded content (LanceDB + fallback)

seed-graph.description: Knowledge graph — connects people, topics, projects, notes, tasks, goals

obsidian.note: No vetted package bundled. Choose and verify an Obsidian MCP server yourself (`npm view <name>`, read the code, pin the version). Do NOT npx -y an unverified name.
obsidian.description: Read, search, and create Obsidian notes

gmail.note: No vetted package bundled. This server receives your Gmail OAuth credentials — verify the package name and publisher (`npm view <name>`) and read the code before installing. Anthropic publishes under @anthropic-ai, not @anthropic.

google-calendar.note: No vetted package bundled. Community calendar servers exist but are individually published and early-stage — verify yourself and request least-privilege OAuth scope (calendar.readonly / calendar.events).

github.note: Official @modelcontextprotocol scope, but the npm package is marked DEPRECATED. Confirm with `npm view @modelcontextprotocol/server-github` and prefer GitHub's currently-maintained remote MCP server if available.

postgres.note: Official @modelcontextprotocol scope, but the npm package is marked DEPRECATED. Confirm with `npm view @modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres`. Connect with a least-privilege read-only role.
